description: This file defines the ProfileReader class responsible for retrieving user profile information from the database, including checking follow status, and mapping database entities to API response models.

classes.name: ProfileReader
classes.description: A class responsible for reading profile data asynchronously based on username, using Entity Framework Core for data access and AutoMapper for object mapping.

methods.name: ReadProfile
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a user profile based on the username, throws exceptions if user not found, checks if current user follows the profile, and returns a profile envelope.
